messages:
Priya: Starting canary for quasar13b-lite (int8). Seeing memory fragmentation spikes + intermittent OOMs on long summaries, and a surprising increase in factual hallucinations in the summarization eval set. attaching logs below, canary is on 2xA100. @Sam please advise

Sam: paste the log snippet and current runtime config? any change in batching / prefetch defaults compared to earlier fp16 runs? :thinking:

Priya: logs: ```
[2026-03-10T12:03:11Z] WARN memory: memfrag_ratio=0.71 slot_compactor:triggered
[2026-03-10T12:03:12Z] ERROR inference: allocation failed during kv_prefetch -> OOM
[2026-03-10T12:03:12Z] INFO runtime: evicted 3 kv_slots, reclaimed 1.2GB
```
config snippet: ```json
{"max_new_tokens":256,"batch_size":8,"prefetch_kv":true,"kv_eviction_threshold":0.6,"slot_compactor":"enabled","quant":"int8"}
```
Repro locally with same model on 2xA100, fragment spikes after ~120 tokens.

Lee: first pass thoughts: reduce batch_size and max_new_tokens defaults for canary. prefetch_kv + int8 can amplify allocation jitter. Try: batch_size=2, max_new_tokens=128, prefetch_kv=false, kv_eviction_threshold=0.4, kv_trim_on_pause=true. Also set warmup_prefix=32 to stabilize early KV allocations.

Priya: will try those. also seeing regressions vs fp16 in ROUGE and hallucination counts — @Eva did the eval run yet?

Eva: ran the quick eval on news-summarization subset: quasar13b-lite fp16 baseline ROUGE-L=0.63 hallucination_rate=3%. int8 canary ROUGE-L=0.57 hallucination_rate=9%. eval path: eval-run/2026-03-10/quasar13b-lite-int8/ (same prompts as baseline). seeds fixed.

Sam: interesting — hypothesis: quantization + prefetch path changes KV layout/timings causing stale/misaligned KV reads during prefix handling which can manifest as context corruption => hallucination. Two-pronged mitigation: (1) operational: disable prefetch and reduce batch to cut fragmentation; (2) runtime guard: detect low confidence / unusual token probs and fallback to fp16 variant for that request. Also set kv_prefetch_padding=0 and generation_window=128, max_gen_chunk=32.

Priya: applied settings on canary: batch_size=2, max_new_tokens=128, prefetch_kv=false, kv_eviction_threshold=0.4, warmup_prefix=32. After a few hundred runs: memfrag ratio down to ~0.45, no OOMs. Quality: ROUGE-L=0.59 hallucination_rate=5% (improved but not back to baseline).

Lee: good progress. For rollout plan: keep canary quantized but restrict to route <=5% of traffic, keep batch_size=2 and max_new_tokens=128 as defaults for this model. Add a regression alert tied to eval job and hallucination_rate > 6%.

Priya: Agreed. Also request: Sam, can you add a temporary runtime policy to fallback to fp16 if first-token logprob < -8 or kv_hit_rate < 0.2? That should catch the worst cases without full rollback.

Sam: can do. I'll open ENG-ML-8421 to add fallback gate + observability hook (tail logprobs + kv_hit_rate). ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Eva: I'll keep running expanded evals (longer articles + conversational prompts) to measure residual gap. Will post updated metrics once batch of 2k evals complete.

Priya: thanks all — I'll update the canary rollout config and add the artifact tag quasar13b-lite-int8-canary-20260310. Running smoke tests now and will notify once metrics are green. :white_check_mark:
